facts.fact: Hespress reported on 23 May 2025 that the CNDP had begun issuing formal notices with multi-month action plans to businesses, starting with healthcare, to comply with Law 09.08, and that about 3,000 pharmacists had taken steps to align.
The CNDP was acting in May 2025, issuing formal compliance notices to businesses.
